legendPrompt: Create a photoreal fantasy natural-history concept plate with THREE clearly separate alternative designs A, B, C, same species. One whole creature per panel, all limbs/extremities uncropped, plain gray background, raised camera30degrees, body mostly side-on turned34degrees towards viewer from side profile, game camera approximate. Ancient wisdom, age, scars and restrained power, recognizably same animal family, each alternative different idea not costume swaps. Anatomically correct limbs, no generic uniform. Titles short. No game screenshot or pixel art. Tarantula, orange-banded hairy jointed legs, eight walking legs plus two short pedipalps, low cephalothorax and heavy furry abdomen. Thorn-scrub badlands: dry earth, rocky banks, thorn trees/junipers, web-hung dead tree. A: ancient burrow weaver, eight thick worn legs frame a low arch, a small luminous sheet of radial silk anchored between rear legs and ground like a rose-window fragment; keep tarantula not orbweaver suspended in orbweb, abdomen scarred and hairs grey at tips. B: canyon listener, enormous feathery sensory hairs on front legs glowing only at tips, orange knees worn pale, body low, no extra eyes ring. C: silk reliquary, old silk threads layered as protective shawl across abdomen with a single tiny bronze thorn offering, thick tarantula legs, no human costume. Prefer B for correct tarantula nature.
